final: {"prompt": "A square, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting that fills the entire canvas edge to edge, with no frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting. Oil and cold wax on heavy linen, built up over many sessions. The left third is dense and turbulent. Slashing, fast gestural strokes of burnt vermilion, hot magenta, and acid yellow cross over each other in thick impasto, scraped back with a palette knife so raw underlayers show through in jagged seams. This is pressure and urgency. Toward the center the marks slow and align. Long, deliberate pulls of deep ultramarine and cold viridian are laid down in steady, overlapping horizontal sweeps. Translucent glazes build luminous depth, and the wet-into-wet edges have a quiet, careful rhythm. The right third opens into a large field of pale bone white and faint grey-blue, thinly scumbled so the weave of the canvas shows. One narrow, tense vein of saturated orange-red runs unresolved through that emptiness and stops short of the edge. This is the space for what stays unfinished. Between the zones the contrast of warm against cool and heavy against bare creates tension, and a few small, stubborn patches of dark charcoal stay unblended where the layers refuse to merge. Visible bristle drag, drips, dry-brush breaks, thick ridges catching raking light, and thin, almost transparent veils. The mood is a tense mind working toward clarity: honest, restless, and steady underneath. Rich, matte-to-satin surface, painterly and tactile. Abstract only, with no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
